messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx + streaming disconnects detected for model redwood/gpt-lite-trace (us-west-2). Rolling 5m error rate ~12% (baseline ~0.4%). Symptoms: chunked responses truncating, client cancellations, gateway 502/504. Paging @sre-oncall :rotating_light:

sre-oncall: I'm on it, joining. Looking at gateway logs + LB metrics. Can someone grab a trace for a failing request id? @alex_chen

alex_chen: grabbing trace now. seeing a lot of 502s from gateway -> inference-proxy with "unexpected EOF while reading" and some 504s from model pool. dumping snippets.

alex_chen: ```
curl -v 'https://gateway.us-west-2.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=redwood/gpt-lite-trace' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***'
> GET /v1/stream ...
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< Connection: close
... "error":"upstream read error: unexpected EOF"
```

maria_ops: rough customer count affected: ~7 active streaming clients right now; 2 on dedicated instances, 5 on hosted shared. Top affected: demo-corp-prod (they see ~10% of calls fail), quickchat-svc (dev). Marking this P1 for streaming feature. Impact: degraded streaming, retries causing duplicate side effects.

sre-oncall: quick mitigation plan:
- increase gateway proxy read_timeout 30s -> 60s (temp)
- temporarily disable streaming for model redwood/gpt-lite-trace (force paged responses)
- scale inference pool +3 replicas
- enable fallback route to stable model redwood/gpt-base for non-streaming sessions

priya_se: I'll patch routing rule to force non-streamed responses for this model now. Pushing change.

eng-runtime: tagging in. seeing KV cache pressure and OOMs on a subset of replicas; suspect a regression where chunked flushes hang and memory accumulates. pulling kube events.

eng-runtime: ```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l model=redwood-gpt-lite-trace -o wide
# pod/gpt-lite-5 crashed with OOMKilled x3 in last 10m
```

sre-oncall: executing live mitigation commands:
- scale pool:
```
rctl scale --pool redwood-gpt-lite-trace --delta 3
```
- update gateway timeout:
```
configctl set gateway.read_timeout 60s --env prod
```
- switch routing to disable streaming for new sessions:
```
routectl set-route --model redwood/gpt-lite-trace --streaming disabled --fallback redwood/gpt-base
```

alex_chen: after scale + timeout changed we see 5xx drop from ~12% -> ~3.5% over 2m. Streaming disconnects decreased but some clients still see truncated payloads.

maria_ops: customer impact update: demo-corp reported incomplete transcripts; they retried which caused duplicate messages on their side. CS notified, working on mitigation + credits.

sre-oncall: next steps: keep non-streaming enforced for 30m, monitor 95p latency and error rates. If stable, do a gradual re-enable of streaming with a small canary. If not, escalate to infra/alloc for rollback.

dana: taking over oncall handoff — will monitor for next 45m. @sre-oncall handing off. I'm online.

sre-oncall: handing off to dana. All runbook actions performed logged to incident doc. https://redwood.internal/incidents/2248009999 (created)

dana: noted. setting alert thresholds: error_rate > 5% OR streaming_errs > 100 -> page oncall.

eng-runtime: follow-up hypothesis: regression from recent continuous-batching change (PR 8342) that altered chunked buffer flush timing; under high concurrency some replicas close connection mid-chunk leading to upstream EOF. If errors persist we'll revert that patch on affected pools.

alex_chen: traces + logs saved to /internal/logs/incidents/2248009999. staged a targeted rollback job (dry-run ready).

maria_ops: CS sending template notification to affected customers with mitigation details and ETA.

dana: monitoring metrics dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/d/streams/streaming-health?orgId=1&from=now-1h&to=now

sre-oncall: status update: metrics stable enough to reduce P1 status; will keep postmortem + action items assigned (eng-runtime/priya_se). Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident status updated to 'mitigated' by dana. Postmortem assigned to eng-runtime/priya_se.
